scope: Finite opportunity-supply audit before another Jev model experiment. A filing cohort is not a list of all current offers or an authorization to trade.
prior_information: Earlier ABUS/WIX/BRRN scouts were already seen. ABUS had a historical indicative ask above the conditional floor. These observations motivated the hypothesis; this is not a blinded discovery claim.

cohort.source: SEC 2026 QTR2 and QTR3 master indexes
cohort.unit: one offer, not each amendment, filing, clause or hypothetical account variant
cohort.limitation: Initiations before the window are out of cohort even if still open. A complete index is only a filing enumeration; offering terms and amendment linkage remain required.

candidate_scope: Exchange-listed common-share issuer cash self-tenders with documented beneficial-owner odd-lot priority. Reject fund redemptions, option exchanges, debt offers, issuer-security mismatches and speculative reverse-split rounding from this hypothesis, preserving counts and reasons.
data_gate: complete dated index coverage for cohort
initiation and all linked operative amendments, current completion/withdrawal/status
original payable terms, security, beneficial-owner threshold, all-holdings rule and acquisition/eligibility dates
documented broker deadline/handling and relevant tax/withholding requirements before an executable claim

economic_gate.holdings: Actual existing beneficial holdings across accounts unknown; use explicitly hypothetical new-holder scenarios until verified. Never assume eligibility from a single account balance.
economic_gate.shares: Whole shares subject to budget and offer-wide beneficial-owner limits; do not automatically assume every offer allows 99.
economic_gate.payout: Lowest contractually permitted accepted cash price, conditional on completion and acceptance; never substitute upper auction price.
economic_gate.deductions: Include documented transaction/corporate-action costs and cash withholding or deductions; unresolved treatment cannot silently become zero for eligibility. A negative gross spread can be rejected without completing deductions.
economic_gate.entry: Timestamped ask with adequate quoted size after a fixed 30-minute manual-response allowance; historical/off-hours observations are screening evidence only, not executable fills. Recheck status and broker deadline before any prospective paper entry.
economic_gate.failure_branch: Retain cancellation, invalid tender, failed settlement and market-value exposure; conditional cash floor is not guaranteed proceeds or expected value.

jev_experiment_only_after_survival.input: Identical original offer/amendment passages and separately verified account/broker facts, with labels excluded.
jev_experiment_only_after_survival.native_test: Parallel atomic decisions with full distributions and predeclared review/abstention logic; compare same outputs with categorical-only routing and an identical-evidence capable conventional model. Freeze exact question panel, labels, thresholds, model identity and cost allowance before calls.
jev_experiment_only_after_survival.arithmetic: Code computes holdings, dates, cash branches and costs. Do not multiply semantic probabilities or treat them as offer-completion probabilities.
jev_experiment_only_after_survival.outcome: Correct eligible/rejected/unresolved decisions, missed valid opportunities, false eligibility and useful review routing; not token cost alone.

stop_rules: If no candidate survives source and conservative economic gates, stop this family build and record the denominator.
One survivor justifies at most one prospective paper case; fewer than two independent offers cannot support a repeatable opportunity-supply claim.
Hypothetical account variants are rule tests, not independent financial opportunities.
If Jev does not improve consequential decisions against controls, do not claim a Jev-specific mechanism even if ordinary tender screening remains useful.
No outcome-based threshold changes, live orders or unrequested background monitoring.
status: index enumeration in progress; no full offer cohort screened, no new Jev calls or profitable opportunity established
